narrative_shape: Read-only census whose shape is standby. From turn 68 the tail is "standing by" and "waiting for the census." Bash climbs 66→137 while Read stays near 8 and the only repeated path is one spec PDF three times. A report skeleton is drafted during the wait. Block counts advance (1200/1836, then 1600). The census finishes at turn 149 and analysis starts. The long run is the monitor, not a code loop.

phases.name: census standby
phases.note: Standing by, waiting on level-0 block lines, arming monitors. Write count sticks at 2 (report skeleton). Monitor 2→3.

phases.name: still waiting, blocks advance
phases.note: Silent bash tails, then prose at 143 and 147 with block 1200 and 1600 of 1836. Compactions appear (2) without a new read set.

phases.name: census done, analysis starts
phases.note: "The census finished. Now running the analysis." One new scratchpad path. This is the end of the wait, not a second shape.

early_signals.signal: "Waiting for the census job — will resume analysis once it finishes."
Bash 66 vs Read 8, Monitor 2, one PDF reread — command wait, not an edit/reread loop.
Still waiting on level 0, about 1836 blocks.
Drafts the report skeleton while the census runs — the wait is the assigned work.

rationale: By turn 75 the session is census standby, and turns through 120 stay there. That is a poll/monitor shape, distinct from the reread loops. The finish at 149 is outcome, so it is not an early signal, and it is not a reason to call the wait thrash.
